headline: Norway Wealth Fund Reports S$38 Billion Loss in Third Quarter
summary: Norway's sovereign wealth fund, the world's largest with S$2.94 trillion ($2.3 trillion) in assets under management, posted an S$38 billion loss for the third quarter.
why: Norges Bank Investment Management is one of the world's largest single institutional equity investors, holding roughly 1.5% of all listed global company shares.

impacts.name: Global Asset Management
impacts.why: Reflects broad asset-valuation challenges and macro volatility faced by mega-scale sovereign asset allocators.
